admission.justification: Prevents writing a document from a different or ambiguous input than the bytes the caller supplied.

applicability: Task-document text inputs admitted inline or by regular file on either supported transport.
conditions: A selected file is read once within its byte budget, and its digest identifies the consumed input.
exclusions: No input is accepted simultaneously inline and by file; no non-regular path or permission bypass is admitted.

evidence: TaskDocByFileTests green: /tmp/mik-run3/L111/a06_fast.txt (65 passed, 78 subtests, exit 0); round-8 verdict notes/reports/reviewer/4889df77-3c01-4cc7-a6ae-344b459490bd/round-8/verdict.md

statement: By-file text inputs ride both transports with the file digest in the answer, and same-input-both-ways plus non-regular inputs are refused before writing.
